history.sg_progress: The Secretary-General prepared a report on the proposed amendments to the Financial Regulations of the United Nations for consideration by the General Assembly in 2019 (A/73/717). The report included regulations and rules for the granting of funds to partners and grantees. Following the formal introduction of the report to the Fifth Committee, the Assembly did not take action on it or on the related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (A/73/817). Another report of the Secretary-General on the same subject is under preparation for consideration by the Assembly during its eightieth session. Once approved by the Assembly, the revised financial regulations will serve as a sound basis for finalizing a Secretariat-wide policy framework on the management of implementing partners and grant recipients.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the legal framework around the granting of funds to partners should be formally introduced into the Financial Regulations and Rules.
history.reference_raw: A/71/5 (Vol. I), chap. II, para. 256
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. With the submission of the report of the Secretary-General on proposed revisions to the Financial Regulations of the United Nations (A/80/367), the Administration addressed the Board’s findings and recommendation by introducing a legal framework around the granting of funds to implementing partners. In 2018–2019, the Umoja grantor module, a corporate enterprise resource planning solution for the United Nations Secretariat, was rolled out, ensuring a harmonized approach to engagement with implementing partners and providing tools that streamlined the financial management of such engagement. The Administration also developed a corporate agreement template, cleared by the Office of Legal Affairs, for engagement with non-governmental organizations (NGOs), which has been automated in the Umoja grantor module as a tool for system-generated agreements.
history.board_assessment: Given that the report of the Secretary-General on proposed revisions to the Financial Regulations of the United Nations (A/80/367) has been submitted, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
